episodes.title: Because I could not stop
episodes.summary: Emily's attempt to publish a poem sparks backlash.

episodes.title: I have never seen ‘Volcanoes'
episodes.summary: Women are forbidden at Amherst, so Emily and Sue get creative to attend a lecture.

episodes.title: Wild nights
episodes.summary: Emily and Austin throw a party, and their mutual love for Sue causes tension.

episodes.title: Alone, I cannot be
episodes.summary: Emily seeks help from an author when her favorite tree is threatened.

episodes.title: I am afraid to own a Body
episodes.summary: Emily confronts tough issues at a meeting of the local Shakespeare Club.

episodes.title: A brief, but patient illness
episodes.summary: Emily takes a "sick day" to write and finds a connection with her father's law clerk.

episodes.title: We lose - because we win
episodes.summary: On her father's election day, Emily defiantly attempts to publish another poem.

episodes.title: There's a certain Slant of light
episodes.summary: On Christmas, Emily tries to be the "good little woman."

episodes.title: ‘Faith' is a fine invention
episodes.summary: During a solar eclipse, Emily confronts the Shadow of Death in her home.

episodes.title: I felt a Funeral, in my Brain
episodes.summary: Emily's relationships are challenged as she moves into a new chapter of life.

episodes.title: Before I got my eye put out
episodes.summary: Emily's insular poetic world is rocked when Sue introduces her to Sam Bowles, a newspaper editor with a strong interest in publishing women.

episodes.title: Fame is a fickle food
episodes.summary: Her participation in an Amherst baking contest gives Emily a taste of fame and celebrity, but she questions the benefits

episodes.title: The only Ghost I ever saw
episodes.summary: Torn about whether to allow Sam to publish her work, Emily hosts a séance in search of guidance.

episodes.title: The Daisy follows soft the Sun
episodes.summary: After some time without news from Sam, Emily begins to suffer from writer's block. To rediscover her inspiration, she ventures into the landscape.

episodes.title: Forbidden Fruit a flavor has
episodes.summary: When she learns that Sam plans to publish her poem, Emily embraces being his latest discovery while attending one of Sue's salons.

episodes.title: Split the Lark
episodes.summary: Things don't go as planned when Emily tries to express her gratitude to Sam during a night at the opera.

episodes.title: Forever - is composed of Nows
episodes.summary: Thinking she's blown her shot at publication, Emily spirals into depression. Her mother attempts to help her with a trip to the water cure.

episodes.title: I'm Nobody! Who are you?
episodes.summary: When her poem is finally published in Sam's newspaper, Emily is shocked to discover that she has become invisible to the world.

episodes.title: I Like a Look of Agony
episodes.summary: To distract himself from the pain of life, Austin throws a tea party for his old college friends—but the day is disrupted by a major political event.

episodes.title: You cannot put a Fire out
episodes.summary: While the whole town attends the christening of Jane's baby, Emily fights to get her poems back from Sam

episodes.title: "Hope" is the thing with feathers
episodes.summary: Amid the Civil War's mounting casualties, the Dickinsons grieve one of their own—and Emily struggles to keep the peace in her family.

episodes.title: It feels a shame to be Alive -
episodes.summary: Frazar Stearns leaves to meet his fate on the battlefield just as the Dickinson family welcomes a new life.

episodes.title: The Soul has Bandaged moments
episodes.summary: Determined to heal the nation, Emily and Lavinia host a sewing circle to support the troops with help from Amherst's finest seamstress, Betty.

episodes.title: This is my letter to the World
episodes.summary: Emily tries to connect with the pain of war by writing to a Union Army colonel and visiting a war hospital. Henry takes a new job teaching soldiers.

episodes.title: Sang from the Heart, Sire
episodes.summary: Emily tries to celebrate her father's birthday with an old-fashioned family singalong, but it devolves into another battle in the Dickinsons' own civil war.

episodes.title: A little Madness in the Spring
episodes.summary: The Dickinsons take a fun family outing to an asylum. Henry helps the soldiers with a uniform inspection.

episodes.title: The Future never spoke
episodes.summary: After a clash with Sue, Emily wishes she could escape from this troubled time altogether. Austin struggles with a man's responsibility in wartime.

episodes.title: My Life had stood – a Loaded Gun -
episodes.summary: On the day of a soldier's memorial, Emily's efforts to keep her family's hope alive reach a breaking point and she descends into a personal inferno.

episodes.title: Grief is a Mouse
episodes.summary: Emily takes steps to ensure that her family won't repeat their past mistakes. The Amherst gang gathers for a fond farewell.

episodes.title: This was a Poet -
episodes.summary: Emily asks Betty to help her design a new dress. The Dickinson family is surprised by an unexpected guest.
